paragraphs.en: The train from 'Frisco was extremely late. By five o'clock, as dawn began to break in the east, it finally arrived at Hugson's Siding. A little girl stepped off the train with a wicker suitcase and a bird cage wrapped in newspapers.
paragraphs.zh: 从旧金山来的火车极度晚点。到了五点钟，东方晨光初现时，列车终于抵达胡格森车站。一个小女孩拖着一个藤编手提箱，抱着一只用报纸包裹着的鸟笼下了车。

paragraphs.en: She also carried an umbrella under her arm.
paragraphs.zh: 她还腋下夹着一把伞。

paragraphs.en: The conductor announced "Hugson's Siding!" The girl walked to the door of the car and was helped down by him. As she watched the train disappear around a curve, she turned to explore her surroundings.
paragraphs.zh: 列车员宣布：“胡根斯停靠站！”女孩走向车厢门口，被他扶了下来。她望着火车消失在弯道后，转身打量起四周的环境。

paragraphs.en: The station shed at Hugson's Siding was bare except for an old wooden bench. No houses or people were in sight. However, after some time, the girl noticed a horse and buggy near a group of trees about a short distance away.
paragraphs.zh: 胡森车站的棚站台上除了一个破旧的木长凳外空无一物。周围也看不见任何房屋或人影。然而，过了一会儿，女孩注意到不远处的一片树丛边停着一辆马车。

paragraphs.en: She approached it and found the horse tied to a tree, standing motionless with its head hanging down almost to the ground.
paragraphs.zh: 她走近一看，发现那匹马拴在一棵树上，头低垂几乎触到地面，一动不动。

paragraphs.en: The horse was large, tall and bony, with long legs and large knees and feet. Its ribs were easily visible through the skin on its body. The boy's head seemed disproportionately big for his body, as if it did not fit properly.
paragraphs.zh: 这匹马身材高大，骨架分明，四肢修长，膝盖和蹄子也很大。它的肋骨透过皮肤清晰可见。那男孩的头似乎与身体不成比例，仿佛有些不太对劲。

paragraphs.en: His tail was short and scraggly, and his harness had been repaired with cords and bits of wire. The buggy appeared almost new, with a shiny top and side curtains.
paragraphs.zh: 他的尾巴又短又稀疏，马具则是用绳子和铁丝修补过的。那辆双轮马车看起来几乎崭新，顶部光亮，两侧还装有漂亮的窗帘。

paragraphs.en: Getting around to look inside the buggy, she saw a boy sleeping on the seat. She set down her bird cage and poked him with her umbrella. He woke up, sat up, and rubbed his eyes briskly before saying, "Hello!
paragraphs.zh: 她终于走进马车里查看，发现里面有个男孩正坐在座位上打盹。她放下鸟笼，用伞戳了戳他。男孩醒了过来，坐起身来，迅速揉了揉眼睛，然后说道：“你好！”

paragraphs.en: Are you Dorothy Gale?"
paragraphs.zh: 你是多萝西·盖尔吗？

paragraphs.en: She nodded gravely at him, her eyes blinking behind gray lashes. "Have you come to take me to Hugson's Ranch?"
paragraphs.zh: 她庄重地点了点头，灰色睫毛后面的眼睛微微眨动。“你是来带我去豪森牧场的吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Of course," he replied, laughing merrily. He jumped out of the buggy and placed Dorothy’s suitcase under the seat, setting her birdcage on the floor in front.
paragraphs.zh: “当然了，”他笑着回答，乐不可支。他跳下了马车，在座位下放好多萝西的行李箱，然后把她的鸟笼放在前面的地面上。

paragraphs.en: "Canary-birds?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: “金丝雀？”他问道。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, no; it's just Eureka, my kitten. I thought that was the best way to carry her," she explained.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，不，只是我的小猫欧里卡。我以为这样抱她是最好的方式呢。”她解释道。

paragraphs.en: "Eureka is a funny name for a cat," he remarked.
paragraphs.zh: “厄鲁卡给一只猫起名真是够有趣的。”他说道。

paragraphs.en: "I named my kitten that because I found it," she said. "Uncle Henry says 'Eureka' means 'I have found it.'"
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“我给我的小猫起这个名字是因为我在找到它的时候想到了这个词。”“亨利叔叔说‘Eureka’的意思是‘我找到了它’。”

paragraphs.en: "All right; hop in."
paragraphs.zh: “好的；上车吧。”

paragraphs.en: She climbed into the buggy, and he followed. The boy picked up the reins, shook them, and called "Gid-dap!"
paragraphs.zh: 她坐进了马车里，他随后跟上。男孩捡起缰绳，轻轻一抖，喊了一声：“吉达普！”

paragraphs.en: The horse did not move. Dorothy thought he just wiggled an ear but nothing more.
paragraphs.zh: 那匹马没有动。多萝西以为它只是晃了晃耳朵，别的就没有 anymore。

paragraphs.en: "Gid-dap!" the boy called again, but still no response.
paragraphs.zh: “吉达普！”男孩又喊了一声，但依然没有回应。

paragraphs.en: "Perhaps if you untied him, he would go," she suggested.
paragraphs.zh: 她建议道：“也许如果你把他解开了，他会自己走。”

paragraphs.en: The boy laughed cheerfully and jumped out to unfasten the horse. "Guess I'm half asleep yet," he said, patting the long nose of the animal. Then he got back into the buggy and took the reins.
paragraphs.zh: 男孩欢快地笑了，跳出来解开马匹。他拍了拍马的长鼻子，说道：“看来我还迷糊着呢。”然后他又回到马车上，接过缰绳。

paragraphs.en: The horse immediately backed away from the tree, turned slowly around, and began to trot down the sandy road.
paragraphs.zh: 那匹马立刻退后几步，缓缓转过身，然后沿着沙土路小跑起来。

paragraphs.en: "Thought that train would never come," the boy observed. "I've waited at that station for five hours."
paragraphs.zh: “原以为那趟火车永远不会来了，”男孩说道，“我在那个车站已经等了五个小时。”

paragraphs.en: "We had a lot of earthquakes," Dorothy said. "Didn't you feel the ground shake?"
paragraphs.zh: “我们这儿地震挺多的，”多萝西说，“你没感觉到地面在晃动吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes; but we're used to such things in California," he replied. "They don't scare us much."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，不过我们在加利福尼亚已经习惯了这些事情，”他回答说，“它们对我们来说并没有多大的威慑力。”

paragraphs.en: "The conductor said it was the worst quake he ever knew," she added.
paragraphs.zh: “导员说这是他经历过的最严重的地震，”她补充道。

paragraphs.en: "Did he? Then it must have happened while I was asleep," he said thoughtfully.
paragraphs.zh: “他确实去了吗？那一定是我在睡觉的时候发生的吧，”他若有所思地说。

paragraphs.en: "How is Uncle Henry?" she asked, after a pause during which the horse continued to trot steadily.
paragraphs.zh: “亨利叔叔怎么样？”她停顿了一下问道，期间马儿依旧稳步前行。

paragraphs.en: "He's pretty well. He and Uncle Hugson have been having a fine visit," the boy replied.
paragraphs.zh: “他还不错。他和胡格森叔叔最近相处得很愉快。”男孩回答道。

paragraphs.en: "Is Mr. Hugson your uncle?" she inquired.
paragraphs.zh: “霍金森先生是您的叔叔吗？”她问道。

paragraphs.en: "Yes. Uncle Bill Hugson married your Uncle Henry's wife's sister; so we must be second cousins," he said, amused. "I work for Uncle Bill on his ranch and he pays me six dollars a month and my board."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，比尔·胡格森叔叔娶了亨利叔叔妻子的妹妹，所以我们应该是二 cousin。”他笑着说，“我在比尔叔叔的牧场工作，他每月付我六美元外加食宿费。”

paragraphs.en: "Isn't that a great deal?" she asked doubtfully.
paragraphs.zh: “这可真是笔好买卖？”她怀疑地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Why, it's a great deal for Uncle Hugson, but not for me. I'm a splendid worker. I work as well as I sleep," he added with a laugh.
paragraphs.zh: “这倒是给霍金斯叔叔赚了不少，不过对我来说可不够。我可是个优秀的工人，干活的效率和睡觉一样高。”他边说边笑着补充道。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy asked the boy his name, noting she liked his cheerful demeanor.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西问男孩的名字，注意到她喜欢他那 upbeat 的神情。

paragraphs.en: "Zebediah, but folks call me Zeb," he replied, slightly embarrassed. "You've been to Australia?"
paragraphs.zh: “我是泽比迪亚，不过大家叫我兹布，”他略显尴尬地回答，“你去过澳大利亚吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, with Uncle Henry. We arrived in San Francisco a week ago and stayed a few days before heading back for Kansas."
paragraphs.zh: “我们是一周前抵达旧金山的，待了几天后就返回堪萨斯去了，和亨利叔叔在一起。”

paragraphs.en: "How long will you be here?" Zeb asked.
paragraphs.zh: “你打算待多久？”赛布问道。

paragraphs.en: "Just one day. Tomorrow we must return home. We’ve been away too long," Dorothy explained.
paragraphs.zh: “就一天。明天我们必须回家了。我们离开太久啦。”多萝西解释道。

paragraphs.en: Zeb flicked his whip at the horse, which stood firm. "That was an awful big quake," he said, his face pale. The buggy swayed dangerously as the earth rose up before them.
paragraphs.zh: 扎比用鞭子抽了一下马，那匹马稳稳地站在那里。“那真是场可怕的大地震，”他脸色苍白地说。随着地面在他们面前隆起，马车摇晃得十分危险。

paragraphs.en: A roar and a sharp crash followed, with the ground opening in a wide crack beside Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: 一声巨响和尖锐的撞击声随后传来，地面在多萝西旁边裂开了一道宽大的裂缝。

paragraphs.en: "Goodness!" she cried, gripping the seat's iron rail. "What was that?"
paragraphs.zh: “天哪！”她惊呼着，紧握住座椅上的铁栏杆，“那是什么声音？”

paragraphs.en: The horse stopped suddenly but remained steady. Zeb urged it to move, first with reins then his whip, as Jim protested before slowly stepping forward.
paragraphs.zh: 马突然停了下来，但依然稳当。赛布用缰绳轻轻一拉，随后抽了一下鞭子，吉姆则在一旁抗议着，最终缓缓向前迈步。

paragraphs.en: Neither spoke for minutes; danger hung heavy in the air. Every few moments, the earth shook violently. Jim’s ears stood erect and muscles tensed as he trotted toward home.
paragraphs.zh: 几分钟内，两人默默无言，空气中弥漫着危险的气息。每隔几秒钟，地面便剧烈震动。吉姆竖起耳朵，肌肉紧绷地向家的方向快步走去。

paragraphs.en: Foam appeared on his flanks, and he trembled like a leaf.
paragraphs.zh: 他浑身泡沫翻腾，颤抖得像一片树叶。

paragraphs.en: The sky darkened, and the wind made strange sobbing sounds over the valley. Suddenly, a tearing sound echoed, and the ground split into another crack beneath the horse. With a terrified neigh, Jim fell into the pit, dragging the buggy and its occupants down with him.
paragraphs.zh: 天空变得阴沉，山谷中刮起的风发出阵阵凄厉的呜咽声。突然，一声撕裂般的响声回荡开来，在马蹄下地面又裂开了一道新的裂缝。吉姆惊恐地嘶鸣了一声，跌入了坑中，连同马车和乘客一起被拖了下去。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy and the boy grabbed onto the buggy top as it suddenly shot into the air. Darkness surrounded them, and they waited in silence for the fall to end or for the earth to close in again.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西和那男孩紧紧抓住马车顶部，突然间车子腾空而起。四周一片漆黑，他们默默等待着坠落的结束或是大地再次合拢过来。

paragraphs.en: The sensation of falling was terrifying, with darkness and loud noises overwhelming Dorothy. For a few moments, she lost consciousness. Zeb remained conscious but was extremely frightened, holding tightly onto the buggy seat, expecting each moment could be his last.
paragraphs.zh: 那种坠落的感觉令人惊恐，黑暗和嘈杂的声音让多萝西无所适从。几秒钟内，她失去了意识。扎比保持清醒，但极度害怕，紧紧抓着马车的座位，每时每刻都以为可能是他最后一次呼吸了。
